$comment: Games in chat (bipe-chat/bipe#1535): par ou ímpar, jokenpô and dice. No server logic; every step is an encrypted timeline event of eventType with a step field, and each phone computes the result itself. Duels (par ou ímpar, jokenpô): the challenger names one opponent; each player sends a commit, and a phone reveals its choice and salt only after both commits are in the timeline. The commit binds the gameId and the player's user ID, so a player cannot copy the other's commit and reveal the same choice. Rolls (dice and the emoji variants): the sender commits a random seed; the first other member whose phone sees the roll answers automatically with its own seed in clear; the sender's phone then reveals. The result comes from both seeds with rejection sampling, so it has no modulo bias. Limit: a person who controls two accounts in the same chat can choose a roll result. No bet or money field anywhere: betting-shaped features are risky with minors. Rules: tools/lib/games.mjs; test-vectors/games.json.
